title: Maze Rush
gameplaySummary: What Makes It Unique Maze Rush must be different from: Maze Rush must be different from: Link Lock: not node-link puzzle solvingMirror Maze: not reflection-firstPipe Pulse / Circuit Clash: not conduit constructionScore Attack / Combo Rush / Clear Rush: not cluster-clearingMemory Flash: not pure memorization without navigation pressure Link Lock: not node-link puzzle solving | Win: Win Condition | Players: 4

tiles.name: Floor Tile
tiles.notes: Base traversable floor. Multiple wear variants prevent tiled repetition.

tiles.name: Wall Tile
tiles.notes: Non-traversable boundary. Corner variants needed for visual variety.

tiles.name: Checkpoint Marker
tiles.notes: Mid-maze waypoint. Pulse animation on idle. Triggered = celebration flash.

tiles.name: Start Tile
tiles.notes: Spawn point tile. Direction indicator shows initial heading.

tiles.name: Exit Tile
tiles.notes: Goal tile. Locked until checkpoints triggered. Unlock animation required.

tiles.name: Hazard Lane
tiles.notes: Timed danger tiles. Warning state before active. Clear idle/danger cycle.

tiles.name: Switch Tile
tiles.notes: Triggers maze reroutes. Activation animation reroutes visible path.

tiles.name: Fog of War Overlay
tiles.notes: Overlay obscuring unexplored areas. Must not block interactability.

pieces.name: Player Token
pieces.notes: Player representation on the maze board. Must be smaller than tile.

pieces.name: Directional Beacon
pieces.notes: Navigational aid showing recommended path or hazard direction.

pieces.name: Reroute Marker
pieces.notes: Temporary path redirection indicator after switch activation.

mechanics.name: Directional Navigation
mechanics.description: Player moves token through maze via directional input.

mechanics.name: Fog of War
mechanics.description: Unexplored maze areas are obscured. Reveal on proximity.

mechanics.name: Timed Hazard Lanes
mechanics.description: Hazard tiles cycle between safe and dangerous states.

mechanics.name: Checkpoint System
mechanics.description: Reaching checkpoints unlocks exit and awards score.

effects.notes: Bright burst from checkpoint, radiating outward.
Exit tile transforms from locked to open with a dramatic unlock sequence.
Red flash with stun overlay on player.
Faint glowing trail left behind player token.

spriteSheets.phaserUsage: individual frame index per tile type drawn to board grid
spriteSheets.styleNotes: Floor tiles: dark slate base with subtle grid texture. Tactical/arena feel. Wall tiles: heavier navy-black, strong edge contrast. Checkpoints: glowing cyan marker on floor. Hazard tiles: amber warning / red-active state.
spriteSheets.gameplayReadabilityNotes: Wall/floor distinction must be clear at 128px and 64px. Hazard state must be unmistakable without relying on color alone (shape + intensity differ).

spriteSheets.phaserUsage: animated player avatar, centered on current tile position
spriteSheets.styleNotes: Premium stylized character token. Compact silhouette (fits in 80×80 on 128×128 tile). Energy trail element on movement frames. Cyan energy core visible on idle.
spriteSheets.gameplayReadabilityNotes: Must be immediately distinguishable from all tile types. Unique silhouette.

spriteSheets.phaserUsage: layered over unexplored tiles; fade out on approach
spriteSheets.styleNotes: Deep navy/dark smoke texture with subtle drift animation. Semi-transparent at edges. Dense at center. Premium competitive feel — not cartoonish fog, more like arena sensor blackout.
spriteSheets.gameplayReadabilityNotes: Must preserve enough opacity to be effective, but not 100% opaque to hint at wall shapes.
